mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_task (task_id, user_id, status, task_code, completed_at, reward_issued, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{taskCode}, #{completedAt}, #{rewardIssued}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_task SET status='COMPLETED', completed_at=#{completedAt}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='JOINED'
UPDATE user_task SET reward_issued=1, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{userTaskId} AND reward_issued=0
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, user_id, status, task_code, completed_at, reward_issued, created_at, updated_at FROM user_task WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT id, task_id, user_id, status, task_code, completed_at, reward_issued, created_at, updated_at FROM user_task WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND task_id=#{taskId}
SELECT id, task_id, user_id, status, task_code, completed_at, reward_issued, created_at, updated_at FROM user_task WHERE task_code=#{taskCode}
